description: CALL THIS BEFORE creating any new function, component, hook, or class. Checks if it already exists in the codebase (prevents duplication), checks for known security vulnerabilities, and BLOCKS writes to protected paths (.github/, CI/CD configs, rigour.yml). Always pass the target file path.

cwd.description: Absolute path to the project root.

file.description: Target file path (relative to cwd) where the code will be written. Used to enforce protected path rules — writes to .github/, rigour.yml, etc. will be BLOCKED.

intent.description: What the code is for (e.g., 'format dates', 'user authentication').

keywords.description: Optional. Words for what it does, e.g. ['retry', 'backoff'].

name.description: The name of the function, class, or component you want to create.

signature.description: Optional. The signature you plan to write, e.g. '(items: T[], size: number) => T[][]'. Matches existing code by shape, not only by name.

name: rigour_check_pattern
